messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: service=inference-routing severity=2 -> high alert volume for routing/latency-exceeded, automated grouping 12 alerts in last 5m. Pager policy: page on sev=1 only; but noisy sev=2 flooding. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-1962501123
Ashok: on it. seeing lots of 504s and 502s from the edge -> likely fallback dust. are customers affected?
Maria: some dedicated customers report timeouts in logs, but only ~2% of requests. public hosted traffic spiky, errors concentrated in us-west-2.
Jordan: echo. I can take lead. first step: suppress repeated sev=2 pages and raise threshold for the noisy alert group while we triage. want to avoid waking folks for noise.
Sam: +1 to suppression. can we differentiate page vs ticket per mapping? e.g., page only if error_rate > 5% for 5m OR p50 latency > 2s for 3m; otherwise create ticket.
Dana: I started a silence for routing/latency-exceeded via ops-silence: `ops-silence create --match routing/latency-exceeded --ttl 30m --owner oncall`
Lee: FYI deploy-bot shows no infra deploys in the window. looks app-level or external dependency.
deploy-bot: [deploy-check] no rollout events in last 60m for inference-routing stack
Ashok: Jordan — can you post the temporary alert rule change so we have exact syntax? ops will need it for the postmortem.
Jordan: sure. temp prometheus rule we pushed to silence noisy signals:```yaml
- alert: routing_high_error_rate_noisy
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-routing",code!~"2.."}[1m])) by (service) > 50
  for: 5m
```This narrows to aggregated spikes instead of per-instance bursts.
Maria: i validated customer 503 logs. root cause looks like a downstream cache timeout (kv-cache) -> fallback to model which spikes latency and briefly overloads workers.
Sam: so mitigation options: 1) increase kv-cache timeout, 2) add rate-limit fallback, 3) adjust alert thresholds. Which do we want now?
Jordan: do (3) now + (1) asap. I'll open a PR to bump cache timeout on the cache-service config; low risk.
Dana: taking the active paging duty for next 45m. if anything changes please @Dana. I'm also creating a condensed incident note.
Ashok: customer-impact note for postmortem: "Transient 502/504s to inference-routing in us-west-2 affecting ~2% of requests for ~20m; no data loss; some API retries visible"
Maria: adding affected customers list to ticket #INC-1962501123-1 (internal).
Jordan: updated alert routing proposal inline: - sev=1 (page): customer-impacting SLO breaches (error_rate > 5% sustained 5m OR p95 latency > 5s) - sev=2 (ticket only): localized spikes or non-impacting errors - map sev=2 alerts to #eng-sre for triage, sev=1 to pager duty and #eng-oncall
Sam: can we add an exception: for Dedicated account alerts, always page at sev=2? they have stricter SLAs.
Lee: agree. Dedicated customers should escalate faster -> map to pager for dedicated-tagged alerts.
Jordan: implementing route logic now, pushing policy change to alert-router:```json
{ "match": { "tags": ["dedicated"] }, "sev": 1, "route": "pagerduty" }
{ "match": { "alert": "routing/latency-exceeded", "region": "us-west-2" }, "sev": 2, "route": "#eng-sre" }
```
incident-bot: automated note: routing policy updated by Jordan @ 1962502200 -> new route rules applied (staged).
Dana: created a quick dashboard: /dashboards/routing-noise-196250 — shows error-rate, latency p50/p95, cache timeouts, and per-customer error tables. Sharing in thread.
Ashok: nice. let's watch for 15m and decide next steps. if noise persists we revert suppression and escalate.
Maria: suppression removed at 1962503500 after initial fix showed lower error rates.
Jordan: cache timeout PR merged: https://git.redwood/p/cache-retries/pull/42 -> rollout started, healthchecks green.
Sam: next steps for postmortem: 1) tune alert thresholds (Jordan), 2) add dedicated-customer routing policy doc (Sam), 3) dashboard saved and added to ops runbook (Dana), 4) run targeted load test for fallback (Lee).
Dana: handing off follow-ups to Jordan for detailed RCA. Jordan — can you own the post-incident action items?
Jordan: will do. I'll put owners + ETA in the ticket.
Ashok: thanks team. final note for handoff: Dana will be primary oncall for 45m, then Jordan will monitor remainder. leaving the channel open for any emergent pages. :thumbsup:
Dana: picking up handoff. logging handoff message in #oncall-handoffs.
incident-bot: incident INC-1962501123 status -> mitigated, severity downgraded to info at 1962504321.
Jordan: will document timeline and proposed alert rewrite in the postmortem draft by EOD.
Sam: thanks all. good coordination. we should add a follow-up meeting to review routing policy next week. :calendar:
thread_summary: Live mitigation of noisy routing/latency alerts: temporary suppression, threshold tuning, per-customer routing rules, dashboard creation, cache timeout fix, and post-incident actions assigned.
